This '''individual''' was an officer on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wielu]]. Sometime in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the officer assisted in the arrest of the crime boss [[Traygura]] after the boss and her entire crew were [[Skirmish at Traygura’s Hideout|defeated]] at her [[Traygura's hideout|hideout]] by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]  [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].<ref name="TSC" />
